name: @neuropause/customer-experience
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Launch Workstream 2: Customer Experience & Commercial Platform. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14, Sprints 1-6, and Launch Workstream 1, unchanged, into the complete commercial customer-experience layer: a customer portal (landing/customer/org dashboards, profile, settings, notifications, activity timeline); authentication + organization (email signup/verification/login/reset, Google/Microsoft, MFA, org creation, invites, teams — reusing the Sprint-2 identity + security platforms with real signup/login/MFA/session); licensing + subscription across Trial/Community/Professional/Enterprise (reusing the commercial + Sprint-6 release licensing); a billing platform representing Stripe/Razorpay (subscription/invoice/payment-history registries — NEVER fabricating a successful payment); a desktop download center (Windows/macOS/Linux AppImage/DEB/RPM with real checksums from the Sprint-6 packaging, honest binary representation); automatic updates (version check/notifications/download/verification/rollback, reusing the release platform + reliability recovery); a customer onboarding wizard (welcome/workspace/AI-provider/org/first-project/invite-team/completion-checklist — never fabricating completed onboarding); a documentation center (reusing the documentation generators); a support portal (reusing operations incidents); customer success (real usage only); a website content registry (represented — NOT publicly live until deployed); marketing asset registries (represented until published); customer analytics (measured data only); customer communications (email messages composed; delivery represented until configured); and governance. Customer portal, authentication, license, download, update, onboarding, documentation, support, and governance runtimes are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; Stripe/Razorpay/email-providers/Google/Microsoft login are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; customer signups/active-customers/revenue/renewal/adoption metrics are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and public website deployment, the production download CDN, payment-gateway credentials, and email-delivery infrastructure are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No real customer signup, successful payment, production website deployment, delivered email, or public download infrastructure is ever claimed; every customer operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
